mapper.select: SELECT dispatch_id AS dispatchId, m_id AS mId, e_name AS eName, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, dispatch_where AS dispatchWhere, dispatch_payment AS dispatchPayment, dispatch_detail AS dispatchDetail, dispatch_complete AS dispatchComplete FROM dispatch WHERE m_id = #{mId} ORDER BY start_date DESC;

SELECT b.dispatch_id AS dispatchId, b.m_id AS mId, b.e_name AS eName, b.start_date AS startDate, b.end_date AS endDate, b.dispatch_where AS dispatchWhere, b.dispatch_payment AS dispatchPayment, b.dispatch_detail AS dispatchDetail, b.dispatch_complete AS dispatchComplete FROM employee_info a JOIN dispatch b ON a.e_key = b.e_key WHERE e_team = #{teamName} ORDER BY start_date DESC;

SELECT dispatch_id AS dispatchId, m_id AS mId, e_name AS eName, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, dispatch_where AS dispatchWhere, dispatch_payment AS dispatchPayment, dispatch_detail AS dispatchDetail, dispatch_complete AS dispatchComplete FROM dispatch ORDER BY start_date DESC;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dispatch (m_id, e_name, start_date, end_date, dispatch_where, dispatch_payment, dispatch_detail, created_at, updated_at, e_key) VALUES (#{mId}, #{eName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{dispatchWhere}, #{dispatchPayment}, #{dispatchDetail}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{eKey});
mapper.update: UPDATE dispatch SET start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, dispatch_where = #{dispatchWhere}, dispatch_payment = #{dispatchPayment}, dispatch_detail = #{dispatchDetail}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, dispatch_complete = #{dispatchComplete} WHERE dispatch_id = #{dispatchId};
